annotations.title: Read or verify a Mizan certificate

description: Read-only. Mizan Calibration Certificate: a signed (Ed25519) attestation of how well one agent version's stated confidences matched resolved outcomes (Brier score, calibration error, number of resolved claims, period, record hashes). Hashes only; never prediction content. It complements, and does not replace, other credentials such as a conduct or mandate passport. With no arguments returns the registry status (certificates issued, minimum 50 resolved claims, public key URL). With certificate_id returns that certificate and its verification. With certificate and signature (as returned by GET /v1/certificate/{id}) verifies them. Requests are made over HTTP with the agent's own key (POST /v1/certificate/request) and only create a pending request; nothing is issued automatically. Testnet; not financial advice.

certificate.description: Optional. A certificate object to verify.

certificate_id.description: Optional. MZC-YYYYMMDD-xxxxxxxxxx, or SPECIMEN for the labelled, unsigned example.

signature.description: Optional. The signature value (hex, 128 characters, no 0x prefix) or the signature object ({algorithm, key_id, value}) as returned by GET /v1/certificate/{id}.

name: mizan_certificate
